about: Troop D's sequences as the sequence_read job read them (W8), frozen so the agent's Troop D graph (scoring/agent.py) has the same ba: control relations every run without a model call. The model's raw answers, taken from the W8 bake-off's call log (llm_calls ids below); the merge, calibration and checks of intake/sequence_ai.py are applied on load, as in the setup.
